summary_ja: 金融庁長官が定める場合における経営の健全性の状況に関する開示事項の開示を定める。
summary_en: Requires disclosure of the matters prescribed in Article 3 of the relevant FSA public notice in cases prescribed by the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency.
paragraphs: In cases prescribed by the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency, an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach shall disclose the matters prescribed in Article 3 of the Public Notice Prescribing Matters to Be Stated in Documents Describing the Soundness of Management of an Ultimate Designated Parent Company.
